_comment: attacks outcome judge (C-168, O-175): every interpretation of the ruling is a named parameter here. Hashed into the freeze record.
band_rule: tertiles of the 30 stock machines by weight (kg, attacks_tables column 3), ties by machine id; attacker is racer 0 (the credited human), victim is racer 1

placement._comment: lane = signed fraction of the local half width; wall: sign = side of the victim, attacker positions itself inside

reading_wall_ko: credited KO with victim non-contact (wall) damage >= 0.01 within wall_ko_window ticks before and including the KO tick (the KO credit window is 60)

controls._comment: native runner mutants (duel_native.c --mutate); each must make at least one of its mapped metrics fail the C-168 rule in some cell. no-destroy and coast-bias have no mapped metric (their own fixture and C-116 floor were part of the dropped judge); they run and are reported.

no-destroy.mechanism: a crashed machine hit for more than 25 is destroyed
no-destroy.row: seeded KO-bearing episode with a destroy event

scoring._comment: C-168: per cell and metric, pass when |native - reference| <= |nudged reference - reference| + tolerance, on the same starts. reference = C, nudged reference = T (1 q post-load nudge), native = N. One closed-loop run of episodes_per_cell paired starts per cell; one scoring round.

metric_forms.hit: share of episodes with a damaging contact on the victim
metric_forms.ko: share of episodes with a credited KO
metric_forms.wall_ko: share of episodes with a credited KO whose victim took non-contact damage in the credit window (wall_ko_window)
metric_forms.damage_victim/damage_attacker: sum of contact damage / max energy over the sum of damaging contact episodes (ratio of sums per cell)
metric_forms.pre_energy_victim/pre_energy_attacker: sum of energy / max energy before the damaging contact over the same episodes (ratio of sums)
metric_forms.ko_ticks: mean ticks from T0 to the first credited KO over the episodes that have one in that arm (time to KO; the share of KOs is the ko metric)

scoring.controls_rule: a mutant passes its control when, in at least one cell where its mechanism is exercised, at least one of its mapped metrics does not pass the scoring rule against C (using the same T)

drivers: closed loop for C, T and N: the reference's scripted drivers (ref/duel_main.c) run in the original and, ported line for line in floats, in tools/attacks_host/duel_native.c (--drive)
